what_this_is: The metric battery and an interpretability test for every k from 2 to 8, on the attribute space the published partition used and on a second space that adds the land block.
grab_bag_rule: the largest cluster's interquartile spread reaching 70% of the spread over all districts
rank_rule: averaged rank over SW, CH, S_Dbw, AVI, AVU and MQ computed within each attribute space; S_Dbw and AVU are ranked so that lower is better, following the practice recorded in notes/competitor-k-2026.md on the internal branch, where the top-ranked entry ranks method by k over six ICVI indices
superseded: These figures are taken on the panel after Hansen and SoilGrids were integrated: the feature space grew from 168 to 172 columns and gained a hansen block of 3 measures and a soil block of 1. The sweep taken before integration, recorded in docs/validation/k-choice.md as predating it, is kept rather than deleted, because a later number that differs is only interpretable against the earlier one - without it, saying the added layers changed the clustering would be an assertion with nothing to compare it to.
